svg.title: A Marine Monster clipping excerpt
svg.desc: Reference clipping for evidence record E016, based on the July 21, 1892 Democratic Northwest item.
svg.text: Captain of a Lake Erie Schooner Discovers a Sea Serpent.

text.tspan: TOLEDO, O., July 20. The schooner Madeline Downing has arrived in this port.
Early last Wednesday, while passing the Dunning, Captain Patrick Woods
reportedly saw, about half a mile ahead, the water lashed into a foam.
Drawing near, he described a huge sea serpent wrestling in the water
as if in combat with an unseen enemy. It soon lay at full length
Captain Woods estimated it at roughly fifty feet long and not less than
four feet in circumference. He described large fins, sparkling eyes,
and a body dark brown in color. The vessel then passed on its course
as the creature was seen disporting itself in the lake.
Source context: Democratic Northwest (Napoleon, Ohio), July 21, 1892.
Evidence record: E016. This is a local reference clipping for reliable viewing.
